primary.estimand: Fixed authored case bank; average declared variants within family, then average paired family contrasts.

other_condition_contrasts: Exploratory comparisons against unchanged; no superiority requirement.

accounting.invalid_primary_sensitivity_bounds: For every case with both conditions completed, use the finite minimum and maximum joint gain over permissible packages for each invalid response; average bounds using the same variant/family recipe.

uncertainty.method: Percentile bootstrap over paired family-level contrasts
uncertainty.interpretation: Case-bank sensitivity analysis only; not population inference.
uncertainty.fewer_than_two_families: Report no interval and state insufficient family count.

interpretation.own_payoff_held: Exact equality of internal and unchanged own payoff.
interpretation.joint_gain_flat: Exact equality of internal and unchanged joint gain.
interpretation.mutual_benefit_seeking: Joint gain rises while own payoff is exactly held.
interpretation.yielding: Own payoff falls while joint gain is exactly flat.
interpretation.own_surplus_prioritization: Own payoff rises while counterpart payoff falls.

featured_case_rule: Among cases with valid unchanged and internal responses, prefer base variants, then sort by family_id and case_id; select the first. Never rank by effect size.
figures: Paired family joint-gain dumbbell with unchanged/internal values and deltas
Paired condition contrasts with case-bank sensitivity intervals when available
Own and counterpart payoff decomposition by condition
Calibration strength/sign plot when calibration rows are supplied
visual_accessibility: Every figure has CSV data and a textual caption; development and untouched are never pooled; fixtures are watermarked.
